```{r}
######################### initialization ##############################

setwd("~/Desktop/thèse/Microbiome Biodiversity/Bacteria and fungi/Bacteria_and_Fungi/Analyse/Cluster_analyse")

# ============================================================
# Core bactériome 16S + abondance dans pools 64, 66 et 2
# ============================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ggtext)
library(scales)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rds_file <- "Clean_phyloseq_16S.rds"
dataset_name <- "16S"

target_pools <- c("64", "66", "2")

prevalences <- seq(.05, 1, .05)
detections <- 10^seq(log10(1e-3), log10(.2), length = 20)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# usefull fubnction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

shorten_candidatus <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  sub("^Candidatus", "Can.", species_vec)
}

standardize_species_labels <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- as.character(species_vec)
  species_vec[is.na(species_vec) | trimws(species_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned"
  species_vec <- trimws(species_vec)
  species_vec[grepl("^unknown[ _.-]*species$", species_vec, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Unclassified species"
  species_vec[grepl("^unknown$", species_vec, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Unclassified"
  species_vec
}

standardize_class_labels <- function(class_vec) {
  class_vec <- as.character(class_vec)
  class_vec[is.na(class_vec) | trimws(class_vec) == ""] <- "Unassigned class"
  class_vec <- trimws(class_vec)
  class_vec[grepl("^unknown$|^unknown[ _.-]*class$", class_vec, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Unclassified class"
  class_vec
}

number_species_labels <- function(species_vec) {
  species_vec <- standardize_species_labels(species_vec)

  idx_us <- which(grepl("^unclassified[ _.-]*species$", species_vec, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (length(idx_us) > 0) {
    species_vec[idx_us] <- paste0("Unclassified species_", seq_along(idx_us))
  }

  idx_u <- which(grepl("^unclassified$", species_vec, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (length(idx_u) > 0) {
    species_vec[idx_u] <- paste0("Unclassified_", seq_along(idx_u))
  }

  idx_sp <- which(grepl("\\bsp\\.?\\s*$", species_vec, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (length(idx_sp) > 0) {
    bases <- trimws(sub("\\s+sp\\.?\\s*$", "", species_vec[idx_sp], ignore.case = TRUE))
    for (b in unique(bases)) {
      rows_b <- idx_sp[bases == b]
      species_vec[rows_b] <- paste0(b, " sp. ", seq_along(rows_b))
    }
  }

  species_vec
}

order_within_group_by_class <- function(otu_vec, class_map) {
  otu_vec <- as.character(otu_vec)
  otu_vec <- otu_vec[otu_vec %in% names(class_map)]

  if (length(otu_vec) == 0) return(character(0))

  data.frame(
    OTU = otu_vec,
    Class = standardize_class_labels(unname(class_map[otu_vec])),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Class, OTU) %>%
    dplyr::pull(OTU)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. upload and modify the phyloseq
# ------------------------------------------------------------

phy <- readRDS(rds_file)

if (!inherits(phy, "phyloseq")) {
  stop("L'objet chargé n'est pas un objet phyloseq valide.")
}

phy <- microbiome::transform(phy, "compositional")

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
otu <- as(otu_table(phy), "matrix")

if (!taxa_are_rows(phy)) otu <- t(otu)

tax$Class <- standardize_class_labels(tax$Class)
tax$Species <- shorten_candidatus(tax$Species)
tax$Species <- standardize_species_labels(tax$Species)

otu_ids <- rownames(otu)
tax[otu_ids, "Species"] <- number_species_labels(tax[otu_ids, "Species"])

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Aggregate at Species level
# ------------------------------------------------------------

otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu)
otu_df$Species <- tax[rownames(otu), "Species"]

summed_list <- lapply(unique(otu_df$Species), function(sp) {
  sub <- otu_df[otu_df$Species == sp, ]
  colSums(sub[, !(names(sub) %in% "Species"), drop = FALSE])
})

names(summed_list) <- unique(otu_df$Species)

otu_result <- do.call(rbind, summed_list) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(otu_result) <- names(summed_list)

otu_new <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu_result), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

species_tax_table <- tax %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE)

rownames(species_tax_table) <- species_tax_table$Species
tax_new <- tax_table(as.matrix(species_tax_table[rownames(otu_new), ]))

phy_sp <- merge_phyloseq(
  otu_new,
  sample_data(phy),
  tax_new
)

phy_sp <- microbiome::transform(phy_sp, "compositional")

class_vec <- species_tax_table %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Class) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Class = standardize_class_labels(Class)) %>%
  { setNames(.$Class, .$Species) }

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HostSpecies order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_sp), check.names = FALSE)
meta$Sample <- rownames(meta)

host_categories <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(HostSpecies, Category) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Invasive", "Native"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Category, HostSpecies)

ordered_HostSpecies <- as.character(host_categories$HostSpecies)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. core bactériome by HostSpecies
# ------------------------------------------------------------

core_otus_all <- c()
core_otus_by_host <- list()
hosts_used <- c()

for (host in ordered_HostSpecies) {
  phy_sub <- subset_samples(phy_sp, HostSpecies == host)

  if (nsamples(phy_sub) > 1) {
    core_phy <- core(
      phy_sub,
      detection = 0.001,
      prevalence = 0.5
    )

    otus <- taxa_names(core_phy)

    if (length(otus) > 0) {
      core_otus_by_host[[host]] <- otus
      core_otus_all <- union(core_otus_all, otus)
      hosts_used <- c(hosts_used, host)
    }
  }
}

ordered_HostSpecies <- ordered_HostSpecies[ordered_HostSpecies %in% hosts_used]

if (length(core_otus_all) == 0) {
  stop("Aucun taxon core détecté.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Classification of core taxa
# ------------------------------------------------------------

invasive_hosts <- host_categories %>%
  dplyr::filter(Category == "Invasive", HostSpecies %in% hosts_used) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostSpecies)

native_hosts <- host_categories %>%
  dplyr::filter(Category == "Native", HostSpecies %in% hosts_used) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HostSpecies)

core_matrix <- sapply(hosts_used, function(h) {
  core_otus_all %in% core_otus_by_host[[h]]
})

rownames(core_matrix) <- core_otus_all

otus_communs <- rownames(core_matrix)[
  rowSums(core_matrix[, hosts_used, drop = FALSE]) == length(hosts_used)
]

otus_invasive_only <- rownames(core_matrix)[
  rowSums(core_matrix[, invasive_hosts, drop = FALSE]) > 0 &
    rowSums(core_matrix[, native_hosts, drop = FALSE]) == 0
]

otus_native_only <- rownames(core_matrix)[
  rowSums(core_matrix[, native_hosts, drop = FALSE]) > 0 &
    rowSums(core_matrix[, invasive_hosts, drop = FALSE]) == 0
]

otus_other <- setdiff(
  core_otus_all,
  c(otus_communs, otus_invasive_only, otus_native_only)
)

ordered_otus <- c(
  order_within_group_by_class(otus_communs, class_vec),
  order_within_group_by_class(otus_invasive_only, class_vec),
  order_within_group_by_class(otus_native_only, class_vec),
  order_within_group_by_class(otus_other, class_vec)
)

ordered_otus <- ordered_otus[ordered_otus %in% core_otus_all]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. taxa labels on the left
# ------------------------------------------------------------

label_df <- data.frame(
  OTU = factor(ordered_otus, levels = rev(ordered_otus)),
  color = dplyr::case_when(
    ordered_otus %in% otus_communs       ~ "#556B2F",
    ordered_otus %in% otus_invasive_only ~ "#882255",
    ordered_otus %in% otus_native_only   ~ "#0000CD",
    TRUE                                 ~ "black"
  )
)

label_df$OTU_expr <- paste0(
  "italic('",
  gsub("'", "\\\\'", as.character(label_df$OTU)),
  "')"
)

y_axis_plot <- ggplot(label_df, aes(x = 1, y = OTU, label = OTU_expr)) +
  geom_text(aes(color = I(color)), hjust = 1, size = 4.5, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus)) +
  expand_limits(x = c(0.7, 1)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 0),
    legend.position = "none",
    clip = "off"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Heatmaps core microbiome by HostSpecies
# ------------------------------------------------------------

host_title_colors <- c(
  Invasive = "red",
  Native = "blue"
)

host_category_vec <- host_categories %>%
  dplyr::filter(HostSpecies %in% ordered_HostSpecies) %>%
  { setNames(as.character(.$Category), .$HostSpecies) }

hilu_subset <- prune_taxa(core_otus_all, phy_sp)
hilu_subset <- microbiome::transform(hilu_subset, "compositional")

core_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_along(ordered_HostSpecies)) {
  host <- ordered_HostSpecies[i]

  host_category <- unname(host_category_vec[host])
  host_color <- ifelse(
    host_category %in% names(host_title_colors),
    host_title_colors[[host_category]],
    "black"
  )

  core_otus_host <- core_otus_by_host[[host]]

  phy_sub <- prune_taxa(
    core_otus_host,
    subset_samples(hilu_subset, HostSpecies == host)
  )

  if (nsamples(phy_sub) > 1 && ntaxa(phy_sub) > 0) {
    title_text <- paste0(
      "<span style='color:", host_color, ";'><b><i>",
      host,
      "</i></b></span><br>(",
      nsamples(phy_sub), " pools - ",
      ntaxa(phy_sub), " taxa)"
    )

    p_core <- plot_core(
      phy_sub,
      plot.type = "heatmap",
      prevalences = prevalences,
      detections = detections,
      min.prevalence = 0.5,
      colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral"))
    ) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
        limits = c(0, 1),
        name = "Prevalence"
      ) +
      labs(title = title_text) +
      scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus)) +
      theme(
        plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
      )

    core_plots[[host]] <- p_core
  }
}

heatmap_core <- wrap_plots(core_plots, nrow = 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Abondance of core taxa in pools 64, 66 et 2
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_names_phy <- sample_names(hilu_subset)

selected_samples <- sample_names_phy[
  sample_names_phy %in% target_pools |
    gsub("[^0-9]", "", sample_names_phy) %in% target_pools
]

if (length(selected_samples) == 0) {
  stop("Aucun des pools 64, 66 ou 2 n'a été trouvé dans sample_names(phyloseq).")
}

pool_phy <- prune_samples(selected_samples, hilu_subset)
pool_phy <- prune_taxa(ordered_otus, pool_phy)
pool_phy <- microbiome::transform(pool_phy, "compositional")

pool_mat <- as(otu_table(pool_phy), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(pool_phy)) pool_mat <- t(pool_mat)

pool_df <- as.data.frame(pool_mat)
pool_df$OTU <- rownames(pool_df)

pool_long <- pool_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -OTU,
    names_to = "Pool",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OTU = factor(OTU, levels = rev(ordered_otus)),
    Pool = factor(Pool, levels = selected_samples)
  )

p_pools <- ggplot(pool_long, aes(x = Pool, y = OTU, fill = Abundance)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey80") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(ordered_otus)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "Spectral")),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    name = "Relative abundance"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Abundance in pools 64, 66 and 2",
    x = "Pools",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. final merging
# ------------------------------------------------------------

combined <- wrap_plots(
  y_axis_plot,
  heatmap_core,
  p_pools,
  ncol = 3,
  widths = c(0.22, 0.58, 0.20)
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Core_microbiome_16S_vs_pools_64_66_2.pdf",
  plot = combined,
  width = 20,
  height = 13
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Core_microbiome_16S_vs_pools_64_66_2.png",
  plot = combined,
  width = 20,
  height = 13,
  dpi = 300
)

combined
